text:
J. Jones (Acme Corp): hey team — our dashboard shows org credits dropped to 0 around 03:10 UTC yesterday, but our billing cycle doesn't end until the 28th. we didn't use anything near that amount. can you confirm when monthly credits are supposed to refill? :confused:

Eli - Support: sorry to hear that. quick questions — can you paste your org_id and the billing day for the account? also which timezone is configured in your billing settings (if any)?

J. Jones (Acme Corp): org_id: org_7a5cdf, billing day: 15, I think default timezone. customer is in PST but we never set a billing tz.

Maya - Ops: tagging BillingBot to pull refill logs. @BillingBot any record of a refill or failed top-up for org_7a5cdf around 03:00-04:00 UTC on 1832504321 window?

BillingBot: automated-log: last_successful_refill for org_7a5cdf = 1829923200 (2027-12-15T00:00:00Z). attempted_refill(1832503200) -> payment_failed (card_declined) ; retry scheduled.

J. Jones (Acme Corp): wait — payment failed? we didn't see any payment alerts. customer says they're on monthly prepaid credits, not automatic top-up. they were just expecting the monthly allotment to refresh.

Eli - Support: ok two paths: 1) if you're on prepaid monthly credits then refill should run at 00:00 UTC on your billing day (unless you set a customer-level timezone). 2) if you enabled auto-topup the refill may create a charge. BillingBot shows a charge attempt failed so auto-topup didn't restore credits. are you sure auto-topup is enabled?

J. Jones (Acme Corp): we never enabled auto-topup. but our billing portal shows "auto-replenish: on" — not sure who toggled it. is there a way to see history of changes?

Maya - Ops: you can pull audit trail via the admin UI or api: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/admin/orgs/org_7a5cdf/audit | jq '.events[] | select(.key=="auto_replenish")'```

Ben - SRE: quick note — there was also a small handful of accounts that saw a double-debit of their token bucket during the DST end edgecase last month, but that was patched. I don't think it's the same, but adding for context.

J. Jones (Acme Corp): ran the audit command. output shows auto_replenish toggled ON by user maya.ops@acme at 2028-02-10T09:12:03Z (they said they enabled a test). so that's why BillingBot attempted a charge. but the customer still expects the monthly free allocation to appear even if auto_replenish is off.

Eli - Support: noted. two pieces to reconcile: 1) why refill didn't apply the allocation before the charge attempt, and 2) why the UI shows credits = 0 even after failed top-up. For (1) refill schedule is: run monthly cron at 00:00 UTC on billing day; if auto_replenish is ON then we attempt a charge for the top-up amount. If charge fails we currently leave credits at 0 (this was design to avoid partial top-ups). That behavior is causing confusion.

Maya - Ops: pulling the server logs for the cron job now. ```[2028-03-15T00:00:05Z] cron_refill: start org=org_7a5cdf billing_day=15 cron_id=refill-monthly
[2028-03-15T00:00:06Z] payments: create_charge org_7a5cdf amount_usd=100.00 -> status: declined (card_declined)
[2028-03-15T00:00:06Z] refill: status=skipped reason=payment_failed
[2028-03-15T00:00:06Z] metrics: credits_left_before=0 credits_left_after=0
```

Eli - Support: that's consistent. customer wanted the free monthly allotment rather than relying on auto-topup. Two recommended immediate actions: (A) temporarily credit the org with the monthly allotment to unblock their traffic, and (B) file billing follow-up to confirm who toggled auto_replenish. Ben — can you apply a temporary override?

Ben - SRE: I can grant a temporary emergency credit via admin API: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/admin/orgs/org_7a5cdf/override -d '{"credits":5000,"reason":"support-emergency-grant"}'``` I'll do that and confirm once done. :white_check_mark:

Ben - SRE: done. grant_id: grant_9f3b. credits now 5000 (enough for ~3M tokens at current pricing). J. Jones can you confirm your consumers can proceed?

J. Jones (Acme Corp): confirmed, traffic resumed. thanks. :relieved:

Eli - Support: root cause summary for case notes: refill ran at 00:00 UTC; auto-replenish was enabled and triggered a payment flow which failed due to card_declined; current system behavior is to skip applying allocation if payment-required top-up fails. That behavior is UX-surprising for customers who expect the monthly free allotment to appear regardless of payment config.

Eli - Support: next steps — immediate: billing follow-up to confirm ownership of auto_replenish toggle and decide whether to disable for this org. longer-term: suggest product change to decouple free monthly allotment from auto-topup payment flow (so customers always get base allocation and auto-topup only adds extra credits). filing ticket now.

Maya - Ops: filing internal ticket: TKT-4521 — "decouple base monthly refill from auto-topup payment failure". will include repro steps and logs. repro steps included below.

Maya - Ops: repro steps for engineers / billing team:
1) create a test org with billing day N and auto_replenish enabled.
2) set a payment method that will decline (simulator) or remove payment method.
3) advance system clock to billing day and run monthly_refill cron: `./scripts/run_cron refill-monthly --dryrun=false --org org_test`
4) observe logs: `refill: status=skipped reason=payment_failed` and `credits_left_after=0`
5) verify customer-facing UI shows credits=0 and no alert explaining payment failure.

Ben - SRE: additional notes on burst: remind support that token bucket/burst windows don't persist across a failed refill — if we want to temporarily allow burst for impacted orgs we can increase the bucket size via override. that's what we did here.

J. Jones (Acme Corp): appreciate the fast help. one ask: can you add a little banner in the UI that explains 'if auto-replenish is on, a failed payment may prevent monthly allocation' — customers lost a lot of API calls and that messaging would have saved time.

Eli - Support: agreed. adding UI note to TKT-4521 and raising with PM.

Maya - Ops: closing the support thread for now. if anything else pops up, please reopen or DM. :raised_hands:

J. Jones (Acme Corp): will do. thanks everyone!
